## Standing operator rules
Separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'enterprise-tenant-onboarding' in between your other work. Run these steps in order, one at a time. Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.

Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.

## Current objective
Complete webhook delivery retries. Router split is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Legacy `query.count()` plus `query.limit().offset()` caused SQLAlchemy warnings; wildcard model imports obscured missing names; pool size 50 caused staging contention/deadlocks; retrying all `HTTPStatusError`s incorrectly retried 4xx failures.

## Recent work
Webhook retries now cover transport and retryable server errors, preserve immediate client-error failure, validate attempts, and use bounded backoff. Eight webhook tests and Ruff pass; full suite has 42 passes and one failure fixed afterward but not rerun. CLI abbreviation regression passes. Acme onboarding steps 1–5 completed; 6–8 remain ordered and pending.
